Rockefeller popped champagne every time trouble hit.

Kevin Trudeau says that without adversity you never grow. You don't build mental toughness and you don't extend your personal power.

He shares how John D. Rockefeller treated every setback as a gift with something in it for his ultimate benefit. It might be a lesson to learn, or something he needed to take responsibility for.

When something goes wrong, do you ask what it is trying to teach you, or only who is to blame?

#ad #success #mindset

Everything was gone. Then he made a decision.

Kevin Trudeau tells how a business takeover left him with no income, and he couldn't even continue in the work he was known for.

He says he didn't know what to do, but he knew there were seeds of a greater benefit in the pain. He decided he would be bigger than ever, even without knowing how.

When did a setback last push you to decide something big?
